route: Selected official Mathlib imports plus exact original focused proof bodies in dependency order.
per_file_outer_section: Each unchanged body is enclosed in a section to preserve local-notation scope. This adds no namespace, assumptions or axioms.
scope_validation: Original namespace/section stacks balance to empty per file; variables, local attributes, local notations and opens are recorded with their active source contexts. The new outer section supplies no variables or hypotheses and isolates each file.
private_name_mangling_note: Private Lean internal names use the extraction module instead of the original file module; source text and proof bodies are unchanged, and private short names are globally unique in this closure.
